name: choco stick jumbo pack
ingredients_raw: SUGAR, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (REFINED PALMOLEIN), COCOA SOLIDS (8%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE FAT (HYDROGENATED OILS), DEXTROSE MONOHYDRATE, MILK POWDER, WHEY POWDER, STARCH, VEGETABLE EMULSIFIER SOYA LECITHIN (E 322), EDIBLE COMMON SALT. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOURS (CARAMEL(E 150c & E 150d)) AND ADDED FLAVOUR (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - ETHYL VANILLIN).
